items.headline: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi Begins First Official Visit to South Korea in Five Years
items.summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi arrived in South Korea on August 19 for a two-day official visit, marking his first bilateral trip to the country since 2021. The high-level discussions with South Korean leaders focus on strengthening diplomatic relations, addressing Korean Peninsula security, and preparing for the upcoming APEC summit.

items.headline: Apple Overhauls European App Store Rules Following Regulatory Agreement
items.summary: Apple announced major revisions to its European Union app distribution policies after reaching an agreement with European Commission regulators [1.1.5]. Effective October 1, 2026, the tech giant is replacing its controversial per-download fee with a simplified commission structure and lowering overall transaction fees for developers.

items.headline: Venus Williams Granted US Open Main Draw Wild Card at Age 46
items.summary: On August 18, 2026, the United States Tennis Association announced that two-time champion Venus Williams received a main-draw wild card for the upcoming US Open. The invitation makes the 46-year-old tennis legend the tournament's oldest singles entrant since 1981, making headline news across international sports.

items.headline: Madonna and Taylor Swift Top 2026 MTV Video Music Awards Nominations
items.summary: MTV announced the nominees for the 2026 Video Music Awards on Tuesday, with pop legend Madonna leading all artists with 11 nominations. Taylor Swift earned nine nominations, leaving her just one award win away from becoming the most-decorated artist in VMA history.
